name: p-iso
exec: (()=>{const S=window.__app.scene;const hits=[];S.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&/church/.test(o.name)){const bb=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(o);const size=bb.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());hits.push(o.name+' vol='+size.x.toFixed(0)+'x'+size.y.toFixed(0)+'x'+size.z.toFixed(0)+' tr='+Math.round(o.geometry.attributes.position.count/3));}});return hits.join(' | ')})()
